questions.skill: Prove the inscribed angle theorem when the center is inside or outside the angle
questions.standard_level: Geometry. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Geometry, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.prompt: Inscribed angle ABC has the center O inside it. Prove that m∠ABC = ½ m∠AOC. (Draw diameter BD.)
questions.prompt_markup: Inscribed angle ABC has the center O inside it. Prove that m∠ABC = ½ m∠AOC. (Draw diameter BD.)
questions.required_method: Split ∠ABC and ∠AOC along BD and apply the diameter case twice, then add.
questions.grading_note: Any valid proof (paragraph, two-column, or flow). Essential: m∠ABD = ½m∠AOD and m∠DBC = ½m∠DOC (diameter case); add: m∠ABC = ½(m∠AOD + m∠DOC) = ½m∠AOC.
